chain.title: First Contact
chain.desc: The baseline Infected Human is everywhere the fungus has spread. Kills drop the body parts - claws, organs, fibres - that literally every recipe in this mod is built from, so start harvesting.

chain.title: Render the Flesh
chain.desc: Any meat plus any harvested body part crafts into Biomass, the mod's base stock: it compresses into tumors and building blocks and feeds most flesh recipes, so it never goes to waste.

chain.title: Pre-Collapse Chemistry
chain.desc: Crush an amethyst shard into Amethyst Dust and mix it with sugar. Compound is the recovered synthetic the old-world scientists built all their gear from.

chain.title: Lost Technology
chain.desc: Smelt Compound into a Compound Plate - the casing for the Scanner, Surgery Table, C.D.U. and every other survivor machine. Ruined labs and hospitals also stock them in equipment chests.

chain.title: Salvaged Electronics
chain.desc: A Compound Plate wired with a comparator, repeater and redstone. This is the brain that the Scanner, Zoaholic and Incubator all need.

chain.title: Scanning Time
chain.desc: Circuit board, plate, observer and a lever. Scan infected mobs and organs to fill out your anatomy log - and heed it when it flashes RUN: that means a Calamity-class horror is close.

chain.title: Field Dissection
chain.desc: A Claw (crafted from a Claw Fragment), a Mutated Heart, Mutated Fibre and a bone. The Infected Knife can be thrown and harvests extra materials from mobs - it pays for itself immediately.

chain.title: Ruins of the Old World
chain.desc: Overrun hospitals, labs, prisons and military camps dot the world. Their organ and equipment chests hold spare organs, Compound Plates, gas masks and even free Scanners - plus Documents recording what happened.

chain.title: Anesthesia Not Required
chain.desc: A crafting table, iron sword, iron axe, glass bottle and a Compound Plate. Surgery recipes assemble harvested organs into infected weapons and armor - this bench is the heart of the whole mod.

chain.title: Still Beating
chain.desc: Stitched at the Surgery Table from Armor Fragments, Mutated Fibre and a Mutated Heart. A Living Core powers the better infected weapons, so expect to make several.

chain.title: Blade of Bone and Sinew
chain.desc: Your first surgery weapon: claws, fleshy bones and a Living Core. Right-click to dash - every infected weapon has a unique active like this, so the arsenal is worth collecting.

chain.title: Plate Over Flesh
chain.desc: Surgery-craft armor from Armor Plates, Armor Fragments and Spines (spine segments bound with nerves). Plated armor is the mid tier - tough salvage from armored infected like Knights.

chain.title: Refining Agent
chain.desc: A Claw Fragment, iron nugget and glass bottle. Refining Agents hone infected weapons; the matching Hardening Agent (Armor Fragment) toughens infected armor. Keep both stocked to maintain living gear.

chain.title: Phlebotomy Kit
chain.desc: Iron nuggets and glass bottles craft four Syringes. Jab an evolved infected to draw its blood sample - each mutated strain carries a different one.

chain.title: Bad Blood
chain.desc: Inject a Syringe into a Volatile to draw a Vampiric Blood Sample. Samples from each evolved strain - berserk, toxic, calcified and more - fuel the mutation system, so start a collection.

chain.title: Local Ice Age
chain.desc: The Cryogenic Dispensing Unit: a dispenser, Compound Plates and iron. It flash-freezes the infection around it, purging mycelium and biomass - your main tool for actually reclaiming infested land.

chain.title: Biocontainment
chain.desc: Compound Plates, glass and a water bucket make two B.C.U. containment tanks - the chassis for both the Incubator and the Zoaholic.

chain.title: Grow Your Own Horror
chain.desc: A B.C.U. wired with a Circuit Board and redstone. The Incubator cultivates infected tissue for you, turning your blood-sample and organ stockpile into a renewable supply line.

chain.title: Discount Radar
chain.desc: B.C.U., Brain Remnants and a Circuit Board. Feed the Zoaholic the organs it demands and it triangulates the Anomaly - the source signal of the local infestation. It will notice you noticing it.

chain.title: I Spy With My Little Eye
chain.desc: The Vigil is the hive's floating watcher. Its Eye is a surgery ingredient you cannot skip - the Respirator and several endgame recipes demand one.

chain.title: Breathe Easy
chain.desc: Surgery-grown from tendons, Alveolic Sacks, nerves and a Vigil Eye: a living rebreather that outclasses the scavenged gas mask for pushing deep into spore-choked ground.

chain.title: Grafted Symbiosis
chain.desc: Mutated Fibre, a Living Core, nerves and a Mutated Heart. Reagents are grafted onto infected gear at the Surgery Table like enchants - this one mends your weapon as the symbiosis feeds.

chain.title: Cold Fusion of Flesh
chain.desc: Upgrade a Symbiotic Reagent with Freezerburned Biomass and an Ice Canister. Grafts Cryogenic Aspect: strikes chill victims to the core. Five other reagents cover bile, acid, thorns and hunger.

chain.title: Living Chestplate
chain.desc: Graft a Plated Chestplate and a Flesh Chestplate together with an Integrating Agent. Living armor is the top tier - armor that is, in every sense, alive.

chain.title: Something Once Great
chain.desc: The Proto Hivemind broods inside the great biomass towers. Killing it strikes at the infection's command structure and opens the path to the true endgame horrors.

chain.title: Mycelial MistMaker
chain.desc: The endgame surgery build: an Amalgamated Heart, all three Reforged Biomasses, spines and innards form a shotgun-chainsaw hybrid that reloads itself on the flesh of your enemies.

collections.name: Anatomy Log
collections.desc: Scan every advanced organ with the Scanner - the mod's own 15-part anatomy achievement line.

collections.name: Blood Bank
collections.desc: Draw a blood sample from every evolved infected strain with a syringe.

collections.name: Infected Arsenal
collections.desc: Every surgery-built infected weapon has a unique active ability - dash, spin, throw, grapple, stun.

collections.name: Living Guns
collections.desc: Endgame flesh-firearms fed with concentrated acid, bile and toxin vials.

collections.name: Grafting Reagents
collections.desc: Reagents grafted onto living gear at the Surgery Table, each carrying a unique enchant-like effect.

collections.name: Survivor Rations
collections.desc: Apocalypse cuisine - if it stopped moving, it's an ingredient.

collections.name: Overrun Ruins
collections.desc: Visit the old world's carcasses - each structure type carries its own loot chests and horrors.

collections.name: Apex Infected
collections.desc: The Leviathan-class and hive-command horrors at the top of the food chain.

notes: Fungal Infection: Spore 2.2. Order source: the jar's own advancements (spore -> lost_technology/scanning_world -> surgery/cdu/zoaholic branches, anatomy_act_1..15 scan line) plus recipe dependency (compound -> compound_plate -> circuit_board -> machines; surgery type spore:surgery; grafting type spore:grafting; blood samples via spore:injection recipes, e.g. syringe on a Volatile yields vampiric_syringe; living_chest grafting = plated_chest + integrating_agent + living_chest -> inf_chest). CDU name 'Cryogenic Dispensing Unit' and Zoaholic organ-feeding/anomaly-tracking confirmed from lang strings. Structures verified in data/spore/worldgen/structure. Entity ids verified against entity.spore.* lang keys (inf_human, vigil, proto, leviathan...). integrating_agent and armor_plate have no crafting recipe in the jar - they are drop/loot items, so they appear only inside descs, not as steps.
